sections.title: New
items: Liquid Glass has a new lens: the edges of glass now bend and magnify what lies beneath them, with a subtle colour fringe and a thin highlight along the rim.

sections.title: Performance
items: Liquid Glass uses less processing power when something on it changes.
Glass animations are smoother when the app has been idle.

sections.title: Changed
items: Release notes are now shorter and easier to read.

sections.title: Changed
items: The Toolbar buttons preview now matches the main window's header.

sections.title: Fixed
items: VideoConverter now restarts on its own after a graphics failure, instead of showing repeated error dialogs.

sections.title: Changed
items: Liquid Glass edges now catch the light like iOS.
Glass bends the background more smoothly near its edges.
The frosted middle of the glass is now a smooth blur.

sections.title: Changed
items: Auto Dim and Text Color are now separate options that work together.
Auto Dim draws one soft wash behind text and dims only as much as needed.
Text Color changes grouped text together, so icons and labels stay matched.
Background check frequency moved to the Liquid Glass page.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Text Color no longer turns all grey text white at the Stronger setting.
Text color changes now fade back smoothly when reversed.

sections.title: New
items: Text Color (beta) changes the text color instead of dimming the glass.

sections.title: Changed
items: The Upload / Download switcher track is Liquid Glass again.
New installs start with the Native engine, the developer console off and the help pill hidden.
Liquid Glass and its Reset now use the tuned look, with a softer Auto Dim.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The Upload / Download selection now follows the track's rounded ends.

sections.title: Changed
items: The Upload / Download switcher wraps snugly around the selected side again.
Cloud Configuration now lists all services on one page.
Liquid Glass is clear by default.
Windows open a little faster, and buttons no longer grow on hover.
New defaults for new installs, including the Ferrite engine and 5 simultaneous downloads.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Multi Downloader glass bars now line up with the queue behind them.

sections.title: Changed
items: Cloud setup moved to Settings → Cloud → Configuration.
Configuration shows the service in use, or "Not set up".

sections.title: Changed
items: What's New now loads from the website, so notes stay up to date.
What's New shows the last loaded notes when you're offline.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Reduce visual effects no longer turns selected items and buttons into blank white shapes.

sections.title: Changed
items: Removed the note under "Show error details automatically".

sections.title: New
items: Software Update: see what's new and install updates right from Settings.
Automatic updates: get notified when a new version is available.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Glass around the preview now picks up thumbnail colors without a hard line.

sections.title: Performance
items: Settings opens without the app freezing first.

sections.title: Performance
items: Menus, pop-ups, dialogs and notifications open more smoothly.
New notifications no longer make the app stutter.

sections.title: New
items: The main window is now Liquid Glass throughout.
The preview card reflects its thumbnail, and nearby glass picks up its colors.
A new switch for the "Playlist detected" banner.

sections.title: Changed
items: The Upload / Download thumb takes on the window's tint.
The main window now waits until it can open smoothly.
Glass edges bend the background smoothly, without streaks.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Thumbnails now fill the preview card's corners.
Quick actions under the preview are readable again.

sections.title: New
items: Liquid: a new motion style where everything moves on real springs.
Windows grow out of the button that opened them and pour back when closed.
The Upload / Download switch stretches as it slides and follows your flick.
Notifications bloom in like the Dynamic Island.
Drop-down lists now animate closed.

sections.title: Changed
items: Header bubbles and drop-down lists keep their bubble opening with Liquid.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Switching quickly between Upload and Download no longer hides both panels.
Opening a window with animations off no longer causes an error.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Video Editor now previews videos Windows can't play on its own.
Video Editor now tells you when a video can't be opened.

sections.title: Performance
items: Liquid Glass now uses almost no power at rest.
Auto Dim checks less often when nothing changes or the app is in the background.
Auto Dim and small glass surfaces are more efficient.

sections.title: New
items: Auto Dim can now darken only right behind text.

sections.title: Changed
items: Text readability is now called Auto Dim (beta).

sections.title: New
items: Text readability now has its own page, with a live preview and a strength slider.

sections.title: Changed
items: The readability check moved from Developer to the new page, with simpler options.

sections.title: New
items: Developer setting to choose when Liquid Glass checks text readability.

sections.title: New
items: A switch to turn automatic dimming behind text on or off.

sections.title: Changed
items: A simpler Liquid Glass page.

sections.title: New
items: Multi Downloader: Add links is now a glass pill that opens into the link field.
Right-click menus are now Liquid Glass.

sections.title: Changed
items: Multi Downloader title-bar buttons are reordered, and their labels follow "Show icon labels".

sections.title: Fixed
items: Text on Liquid Glass stays readable over bright or busy backgrounds.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The shade behind the Settings page title now fades smoothly between pages.

sections.title: New
items: What's New is now sorted by version, all the way back to the first release.
Multi Downloader: select all with one circle, and see the total length and estimated size.

sections.title: Changed
items: Multi Downloader has a tidier toolbar and smaller cards.
New installs start with Smooth Liquid animations.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Multi Downloader no longer lags when idle.
Long queues scroll more smoothly.

sections.title: New
items: Video Editor snaps to the video's shape after resizing.
The Settings page title stays readable while you scroll.
Windows are fully opaque by default.

sections.title: Changed
items: Removed the blur behind windows, which was unreliable on Windows 11.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Video Editor and Log Viewer borders are fully visible again.

sections.title: New
items: Video Editor redesign with a single Liquid Glass platform.
New editor controls under the timeline, plus Space to play or pause and Esc to close.
The editor window takes the video's shape, with no black bars.
Multi Downloader bars and title-bar buttons are now Liquid Glass.
Glass stays readable on bright backgrounds.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The first Liquid Glass window no longer pauses while opening.

sections.title: New
items: A new installer that sets up everything VideoConverter needs.
The Legacy engine is no longer supported, and is available as a manual download.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed "Ferrite engine not found" after installing.

sections.title: New
items: Liquid Glass: notifications and menus now look like real glass.
All drop-down menus are now Liquid Glass.
Pop-ups and dialogs are now Liquid Glass.
Choose from Clear to Tinted glass, with a live preview.
Glass Tuner: a developer tool to adjust glass live.
Classic frosted glass without hardware graphics acceleration.

sections.title: New
items: Ferrite: a new engine that runs in its own process, so a crash can't close the window.
Ferrite can upload to YouTube.
Choose between three engines: Native, Ferrite and Legacy.
Settings → Info shows the active engine.
A new error window explains what went wrong and how to fix it.
Error notifications name the problem and link to details.
Multi Downloader shows what went wrong and what to try.
Slim scroll bars that appear only when needed.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Switching engines no longer cancels a running job.
Multi Downloader keeps working after an engine switch.
Legacy cloud uploads now fail with a clear message.
The Native upload message now points to Ferrite or Legacy.
Metadata errors now show the actual reason.
Errors now reflect where a download actually stopped.

sections.title: New
items: Smooth scrolling with the mouse wheel.
Middle-click autoscroll in Multi Downloader.
Expandable sections share one design and slide open smoothly.
Theme Designer now uses glass toggle switches.
After-download buttons fill their card and resize smoothly.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Jobs no longer freeze on heavy FFmpeg or yt-dlp output.
GPU acceleration now works on AMD and Intel graphics, with a CPU fallback.
Stopping a batch now stops its running downloads.
Closing an old progress window no longer cancels a newer job.
Subtitle files no longer contain log lines.
Saving Settings keeps custom theme colors, and cancelled language changes are reverted.
The Disabled preset and Performance Mode now turn animations off.
The drop zone's Cancel button works again.
Switching Settings tabs no longer jumps.
Fixed a crash when resizing with certain monitor layouts.
Fixed a crash when restarting the engine from the developer console.
Legacy engine fixes for playlist links, M4A/FLAC and cancelling queued jobs.

sections.title: Performance
items: The engine now starts in the background.
Theme Designer changes are faster.
Logs no longer slow down over time.
Cloud uploads and folder detection are more efficient.
Multi Downloader loads links faster.
The performance overlay shows real CPU usage and UI latency.

sections.title: Cleanup
items: Removed about 1,200 lines of unused code.

sections.title: New
items: Multi Downloader: a batch queue for playlists.
Up to 30 simultaneous downloads.
Cloud upload.
Build Info in Settings.
Cookies file support for private or members-only videos.

sections.title: Improved
items: A better organized Advanced tab.
Redesigned notifications.
Redesigned presets.
Stability and performance improvements.

sections.title: New
items: A native C# engine.
Performance Mode.
Dynamic layout.
A new theme manager.

sections.title: Improved
items: A refined design.
Improved loading bar.
Improved download and upload fields.
Thumbnail previews scale when resizing.
The Customize tab works as expected.

sections.title: Misc
items: FFmpeg installs automatically on first use.
FFmpeg can be added to PATH with admin access.
Upgraded to .NET 10.
Upgraded WPF-UI.

sections.title: New
items: YouTube Music downloads at up to 320 kbps, with full metadata.
Five new languages: Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Chinese.
The progress window shows each phase with speed and time left.
Notifications when a job succeeds or fails.
Resize any window with a corner grip.
A redesigned Designer window.

sections.title: Improved
items: Cleaner rounded window corners.
Blur is on by default for the Log Viewer, Developer Console and Description Editor.
A fixed Sandstone preset and cleaner pop-ups.
Reworked animations.

sections.title: Misc
items: Console log filters and a compact mode.

sections.title: New
items: Choose between the progress window and a progress bar.
Scroll bars can be turned off.
Animation levels: None, Reduced and Standard.
A new way to add and save presets.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Windows no longer flicker or stretch when opening.
Better contrast in the light theme, and a subtler Beta tag.

sections.title: New
items: Video Editor with built-in Whisper subtitles.
Design Editor and a better Settings window.
GPU acceleration for NVIDIA graphics cards.
Better logging and a troubleshooting console.
Download video in up to 4K, or audio only.
Metadata and media changes to avoid duplicate detection.
Automatic YouTube upload with your own API key.

sections.title: Improved
items: A new design and better performance.

sections.title: New
items: A Settings window that remembers your preferences.
Quick actions for loaded metadata.
A DE / EN switch, and the workflow guide moved to the ? button.

sections.title: Improved
items: Cleaner logs, a smooth Settings animation and a scrolling left panel.
Shorter German button labels.

sections.title: New
items: A standalone app with a Python backend.
FFmpeg downloads automatically on first start.
YouTube upload with your own Google Cloud credentials.
Fingerprint bypass options: metadata, light, standard and strong.

sections.title: New
items: Where it all began: console scripts that turn an Instagram Reel into a YouTube Short.
Fingerprint bypass with changes invisible to viewers.
AI-written YouTube titles from OpenAI.
Captions and hashtags become the description and tags.
A recurring mode and a compilation script.
Dependencies install automatically on first start.
